title: Panthers TE Tommy Tremble: I taunted Cooper DeJean because of his "egregious" hit on teammate

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Panthers TE Tommy Tremble: I taunted Cooper DeJean because of his "egregious" hit on teammate
sources.description: Panthers tight end Tommy Tremble punctuated his second touchdown of Sunday's 25-14 win over the Eagles by turning toward and pointing at defensive back Cooper DeJean.
